trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Follow the roadmap stages in order and it will unlock last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you play; because it is a one-time story beat, do not skip the opening sequence.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the first chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Keep playing the story missions in order until the chapter ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story progress only — finish every mission the chapter asks for.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter. Finish its missions to close it out.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story's last mission and the gold pops with the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — it can only be earned while that mission is available, so play it when it appears and do not rush past it.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission; finish it when the story offers it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission; play it when it appears in the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission; finish it during your playthrough.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a story mission at the airport. Finish it when the story offers it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A story mission; finish it during the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The game's own completion checklist — story, side content, collectibles and activities — must all be finished. Check the in-game stats page to see what is left; this is the long grind and it is best saved for last.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Chain jumps, near misses and airtime while driving around Leonida; stunts add up over normal play, so watch the counter and mop up the remainder with repeated jumps.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample every activity type the game offers — one attempt at each is enough, you do not need to win or finish them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every range challenge and replay any that fall short of gold; steady aim and the right weapon for each challenge matter more than speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Win one drone race at each Top Fun spot around the map.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same race do not count twice, so keep entering new races until twenty distinct ones are won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Take it when the opportunity appears, since a missed fishing challenge may not come back.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet through to the end of one game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's strand of side missions through to his last one.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's side-mission strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's side-mission strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Find stranger missions around the state and finish eight full strands; the map markers and the strangers you meet while exploring point the way.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's side-mission strand.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's side-mission strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state, so work through them while exploring and tick them off as you find them.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track down the unique animal Bret asks for and hunt it; the animal and area are named in Bret's strand, so follow his missions.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Gather cards hidden around Leonida until three full sets are complete; sweep each area carefully, since cards sit in easy-to-miss spots.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at one hundred different spots; it adds up while you travel, so use it whenever you pass somewhere new.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Finish fifty of the game's challenges across all types; pick the quick ones first and let the total grow as you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Build a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape. Do it while a partner is available — a solo escape does not count.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level alive between them; plan a route through three nearby shops.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter one hundred different vehicles; a new model counts when you first get in it, so try everything you see on the road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends; pick a busy firefight and line the shots up.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned — steal a plane and take off without clearance. One bold exit is all it takes.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — expect to face military Rhino tanks, most likely by surviving or destroying them when they appear at high wanted levels. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the robbery quietly: scout the store, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time; bring a fast getaway vehicle and a planned escape route.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cargo and escape before the police close in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every area of the state; the map fills in as you travel, so drive every road and check the map for gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one illegal operation for each gang across Leonida.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit down for a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and take in the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's frontage — the classic getaway.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the bowling alley and see it through to the end.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A partner moment tied to your duo's reputation — keep playing partner content and it will come. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count up to 500 — make choices as you play and the total climbs over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something once, then succeed on the second try — a retry that lands.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — keep an eye out for the game's odd, unexplained moments while exploring Leonida.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills through your laundering contacts until $250,000 is clean; keep laundering as the bills come in.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food and more all count, and the total adds up across the whole game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage property across Leonida; save up and purchase each one as it becomes available.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you find or own in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.src: Exophase + PSNProfiles (official list); guide from the official description, unplayed
